title: Very poor support for an app that is happy to take your money
body: Be careful buying cards on the marketplace, because the print icon isn’t always reliable. I bought a Topps Finest card on the marketplace for 8,888 coins. It displayed the print icon and said I had 1 print-ready copy, but it never appeared in the print section. It took nearly a month of emails to learn that the card is from last season, that the printing deadline had passed, and that the app was incorrectly showing it as printable. Support confirmed this was a bug in the app. Even so, they refused to refund the coins I spent based on what the app told me. They offered 500 Gold as “goodwill” for the wait, said it wasn’t compensation for the card, and then closed the case. Along the way I was asked the same questions repeatedly, including to check things my original message and screen recording had already shown. I like the game and have spent real money on printed cards, but I can’t trust what the app displays, and I can’t count on support to fix it when it’s wrong.
